bypass_options.notes: Indonesia: deeper-water alternate south of Malacca, used by very large crude carriers (VLCCs) too big for some Malacca shallows. Real route, not a diversion -- adds only ~1-2 days. Estimate.
Indonesia: shallower alternate, mainly smaller vessels. Adds ~1 day. Estimate.

explanation: 2,940,000 bpd depends on malacca. Pipeline/alternate-strait bypasses (Lombok/Makassar Strait, Sunda Strait) can absorb all of it with little to no added transit time.
